sources.title: Kestrel ingest service
sources.snippet: The Kestrel ingest service listens on TCP port 7413. It is owned by the Tidewater team, is written in Rust, and stores batches in ClickHouse.

sources.title: Kestrel release calendar
sources.snippet: The Kestrel release freeze for version 4.2 begins on 16 November 2026.

sources.title: Skerry backup server
sources.snippet: Skerry, the lab's backup server, keeps nightly snapshots for 45 days.

sources.title: On-call rota
sources.snippet: The Halvorsen Lab on-call rota changes over every Tuesday at 09:00.
